study_label: MEASURE trial of tocilizumab plus methotrexate in rheumatoid arthritis

objective.value: To define the effects of tocilizumab (TCZ) on vascular risk surrogates in patients with rheumatoid arthritis, with primary hypotheses that TCZ would reduce pulse wave velocity (PWV) and small LDL particles.

population.value: Adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed by American College of Rheumatology criteria for more than 6 months, with inadequate response to stable methotrexate therapy, swollen and tender joint counts each at least 6, and CRP >10 mg/L or ESR >28 mm/h. Patients with inadequate response to an anti-TNF agent within 6 months before baseline or to more than two previous anti-TNF agents were ineligible.

intervention.value: Blinded intravenous tocilizumab 8 mg/kg every 4 weeks plus background oral methotrexate (7.5–25 mg weekly) for the randomized treatment period.

comparator.value: Blinded placebo plus background oral methotrexate.

duration_follow_up.value: The randomized blinded treatment period was 24 weeks (6 months), with primary assessment at week 12 and secondary assessment at week 24. After 24 weeks, patients were offered open-label TCZ plus MTX; 92 patients completed treatment for 96 weeks.

primary_outcome.value: Co-primary outcomes were the effect at 12 weeks on arterial stiffness measured by pulse wave velocity (PWV) and small LDL particle number assessed by nuclear magnetic resonance, compared with placebo.

effect_result.value: At week 12, small LDL particle concentration did not differ significantly between TCZ and placebo (adjusted mean difference −0.0 nmol/L, 95% CI −115.0 to 115.0). PWV showed a significant between-group difference (adjusted mean difference 0.79 m/s, 95% CI 0.22 to 1.35; p=0.0067), reflecting a greater relative PWV reduction with placebo than TCZ (−0.99 vs −0.21 m/s). The PWV group difference was not sustained at week 24 (adjusted mean difference 0.30 m/s, 95% CI −0.27 to 0.87; p=0.30); small LDL also showed no significant difference at week 24.

safety.value: Adverse events and serious adverse events during the trial were reported as similar to those observed in previous TCZ studies; event counts and specific events were not provided in the extracted evidence.

sample_size.analyzed: ITT analyses were reported, but the exact number analyzed for each primary outcome was not explicitly reported in the extracted evidence.
sample_size.display: Randomized: 132 (69 TCZ+MTX; 63 placebo+MTX); planned: 120 (60 per arm); exact primary-outcome analysis population not explicitly reported

evidence_questions.objective: To assess the effect of tocilizumab on vascular risk surrogates, specifically PWV and small LDL particle number.
evidence_questions.population: Adults with moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis with inadequate response to stable methotrexate therapy.
evidence_questions.intervention: Intravenous tocilizumab 8 mg/kg every 4 weeks plus oral methotrexate.
evidence_questions.primary_outcome: Change at 12 weeks in PWV and small LDL particle number assessed by nuclear magnetic resonance.
